reviewer: Codex primary agent, direct original-resolution visual inspection
scope: P0 train-only sampled visibility permission, not acceptance of a complete robustness benchmark

reviewed_images.findings: Original 256px A/B tiles inspected. Bright/dark variants preserve house/tree context; bright roofs partially clip. Very small positive label cannot be independently localized semantically even in this clean overview; no claim of universal tiny-target observability.

Original 256px A/B tiles inspected. Both contrast directions preserve road/field and small roof footprints at labelled positions; reduction lowers contrast and increase clips light road pixels without deleting target geometry.

Original 256px A/B tiles inspected. Gamma 0.5 and 2.0 preserve the labelled lower-left building footprint; dark shadows lose fine texture but building outline remains visible. No geometry change observed.

Original 256px A/B tiles inspected. All four color shifts retain industrial roofs and lower-right changed region geometry, including the clipped tile border; tint is artificial and not a claim of natural acquisition realism.

Original 256px A/B tiles inspected. Multiple labelled new building footprints remain discernible in brighter and darker versions; brighter A construction area partly saturates, while principal outlines remain.

Original 256px A/B empty-label tiles inspected. Surface texture remains under both contrast directions; no geometry discontinuity or masked-region boundary was introduced. Empty label is inherited, not visually reannotated.

Original 256px A/B large-positive tiles inspected. All four color shifts retain multiple construction/building footprints. Per-channel clipping/tint occurs; no disappearance of the main structures was observed.

limitations: Seven original-resolution sheets; five positive-area strata plus an empty anchor, not exhaustive inspection of all 64 samples.
Strong tint/clipping and very small existing labels remain limitations. No guarantee of all targets being semantically recognizable.
Independent finite draws retain identical u/v; no score-conditioned resampling. Results are enriched-train diagnostics, not held-out scientific validation.
